items.headline: Friday's BTC ETF print flips to a small inflow after two heavy exit days
items.blurb: US spot bitcoin ETFs completed Friday at about +$21M after losing ~$485M on Oct 7 and ~$244M on Oct 8 — the heaviest two-day stretch since June. October is still net negative.
items.why_matters: The week was defined by institutional redemptions; Friday's small green print breaks the streak and makes Monday's flow the next tell before CPI.

items.headline: BTC holds near $83k into Sunday after defending the $80k area
items.blurb: After breaking the post-Sept-21 ~$83k floor midweek and probing ~$80k Thursday, bitcoin settled back near ~$82.9k over the weekend as oil fears eased.
items.why_matters: Holding ~$80k kept the monthly uptrend intact; reclaiming and holding ~$83k into CPI week is the near-term tell.

items.headline: Macro calendar: September CPI on Oct 14, then the Oct 27–28 FOMC
items.blurb: Markets head into the week watching Wednesday's inflation print and the late-October Fed meeting, after September's hike and hawkish minutes helped reset rate expectations.
items.why_matters: A hot CPI could revive hike bets and keep pressure on risk assets; a cooler print would ease the liquidity headwind that weighed on ETF demand this week.

items.headline: Futures leverage flush continues but is moderating
items.blurb: CheckOnChain still shows a Deleveraging Sell-Off: seven-day futures OI down about 1.7% alongside a ~2.0% price drop, with funding mild and positive (~+2.6% ann.).
items.why_matters: Leverage is still being cleared rather than added — less fuel for forced selling than a leveraged washout, but also less dry powder for a fast squeeze.

items.headline: RSDH stays SOL-heavy BULL; trail vs BTC narrowed overnight
items.blurb: Investorius RSDH remains SOL95/BTC5/CASH0 under a BULL macro with fast momentum still easing. Final× 1.25 vs BTC 1.32 — trail 0.07 after strat ticked up while BTC Final× held.
items.why_matters: The model is still fully invested and ahead of BTC MoM, but a rough week of SOL lag means it trails BTC on Final× into CPI week.
